[{"insert":"Pronated Strict Pullup
 
The pronated strict pullup runs as a density block rather than a super set this week. Six sets go every seventy five seconds with reps descending five, three, two and then repeating, so the rest shrinks relative to the effort as you go. Palms face away, and the 21X0 tempo means two seconds down with a one second hang at the bottom before the next rep. Add weight or take away assistance as the reps drop, and aim to improve on this every even week of the block.
"}]
